mapper.select: select id, batch_no, season_id, settlement_batch_id, batch_status, honor_count, operator_id, error_message, current_flag, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_honor_generation_batch where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select id, batch_no, season_id, settlement_batch_id, batch_status, honor_count, operator_id, error_message, current_flag, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_honor_generation_batch where season_id = #{seasonId} and current_flag = 1 and is_delete = 0 order by id desc limit 1

select b.id, b.batch_no as batchNo, b.season_id as seasonId, s.season_name as seasonName, b.settlement_batch_id as settlementBatchId, b.batch_status as batchStatus, b.honor_count as honorCount, b.operator_id as operatorId, b.error_message as errorMessage, b.current_flag as currentFlag, b.create_time as createTime, b.update_time as updateTime from basket_honor_generation_batch b left join basket_season s on s.id = b.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where b.is_delete = 0 and b.season_id = #{seasonId} order by b.id desc
